chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Nuʿmān, from Saʿīd al-Aʿraj and Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

If you begin the salat (prayer) and forget to give the adhan and iqamah, then remember before you perform ruku', turn away, give the adhan and iqamah, and begin the salat (prayer). But if you have already performed ruku', then complete your salat (prayer).

key_terms.تَرْكَعَ: to perform ruku', the bowing posture in prayer
key_terms.تُؤَذِّنَ: to recite the adhan, the call to prayer
key_terms.تُقِيمَ: to recite the iqamah, the commencement call before prayer
key_terms.فَانْصَرِفْ: withdraw from the prayer you have begun

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he forgets the adhan and iqamah after starting salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who forgets the adhan and iqamah after beginning salat (prayer). If he remembers before ruku', he should leave the prayer, perform the adhan and iqamah, and restart; but if he has already performed ruku', he should continue and complete the prayer.
